summary: This visual presents an evaluation of test time reinforcement learning methodologies, focusing on the reliability of different models as indicated by the AIME, AMC, and MATH500 metrics. The left section categorizes models A, B, C, and D, with B marked as skewed and C as reliable. The right section features a bar chart comparing performance metrics across models, with AIME showing a peak value of 31.6, AMC with a maximum of 17.8, and MATH500 reaching 5.5. The average performance across these metrics is also highlighted, indicating a trend of varying reliability and effectiveness among the models.
